entries.name: WP2 plug-in foundations
entries.why: Measured growth of the start (plan allowance 1.0 KB): the emit sites in main.ts and hud-combat.ts, the sending end of the event bus, the features loader with its one retry, bossApproach, and addPhrases in i18n.ts. The bus, the services and every feature load after Start.

entries.name: WP10 hero gait blend
entries.why: Measured growth of the start (plan allowance 0.3 KB): hero-motion.ts, the blend between the idle and the walk pose that runs from the first frame, in place of the switch in world.ts animatePlayer. The lean-in, the settle, the fidgets, the sit and the clips load after Start (features/hero-idle.ts).

entries.name: WP24 fair rewards and true words
entries.why: Measured growth of the start against staging 48da5cb (English 797,451 -> 797,634, Vietnamese 930,833 -> 931,026). The plan allowed 0.1 KB (102 bytes): this is 81 and 91 bytes over it, after the level-20 News sentence was cut back to its old length. What is left is rule code that both sides run and the hook: the bounty cap with the creature kept in the bounty log (progression.ts; the zone table now sits beside the spawn tables in enemy-types.ts), the soothed rate in grantColossusReward and the roar bonus on the EXP paid (colossus-rewards.ts, shared with the server and folded into a start chunk), the one-line well hook in main.ts, and '1 day in a row' with its Vietnamese. Loaded on demand, not in the start: the well's view (colossus-well-ui chunk, 1.8 KB gzip with the gift's clock guard and the awake-day rule; the plan row says 1.5 KB), its Vietnamese (features-vi, +1.0 KB of that chunk's 15 KB) and Automatic's pay rule (colossus.ts, the modes chunk). news.json is 20 bytes smaller.
